function.header_comment:
/************************************************************************
 * VarBoolFromCy (OLEAUT32.124)
 *
 * Convert a VT_CY to a VT_BOOL.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  cyIn     [I] Source
 *  pBoolOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
